description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of articles across years” represents how the articles in the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse” are distributed across publication years, showing three slices in total. The slices are labeled by year with percentage and count values printed inside each segment: 2019 is shown in blue at approximately 46.0% (46), 2018 is shown in orange at approximately 33.0% (33), and 2017 is shown in green at approximately 21.0% (21). There is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments appear arranged so that the largest share (2019) is followed by smaller shares (2018, then 2017).
